mechanism: Azithromycin can inhibit CYP3A4 and potentially increase phenelzine levels; phenelzine is an MAOI with serotonergic activity creating additive CNS and cardiovascular risks including potential serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use with caution, monitor blood pressure closely, educate patient on tyramine-rich foods, and watch for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, muscle rigidity).
